Home.Earth is looking for a Head of Operations

We are looking for a purpose-driven and versatile Head of Operations to lead our operations team and take full P&L responsibility for our operating properties.

Home.Earth was founded in 2021 and is one of Denmark’s most ambitious and fastest-growing property companies. We have a unique tenant concept that includes a discount scheme for our tenants based on the surplus of each individual property. We also want to fundamentally change the often conflict-ridden relationship between tenant and landlord, which is why we have chosen to keep all administration, property operations, leasing and communication in-house.

Our current portfolio of operating properties consists of five properties in Greater Copenhagen. During the spring, it will grow to approximately 700 units and will then continue to grow steadily for many years to come.

The role

As Head of Operations, you will join the management team and be responsible for Home.Earth’s operating property portfolio. That means you will own our team, our concept and the P&L of each property. The portfolio consists mainly of our own new developments and acquired properties, and secondarily of commercial leases. You set the direction for operations and are accountable for results to management, colleagues and our investors.

The role combines strategy, commercial acumen and hands-on operational leadership. You think long-term about how we create value in our properties for all our stakeholders. At the same time, you stay close to day-to-day operations, so you know the properties, the tenants and the numbers, and you are ready to roll up your sleeves when needed.

Leadership is a central part of the role, and you should be motivated by helping your colleagues succeed and by building a first-class property management organization. You will lead the entire in-house property management function, which covers administration, caretakers, customer service and leasing. You are responsible for ensuring that the team thrives, develops and grows in step with the portfolio. We expect an empathetic and purpose-driven leadership style, where you lead from the front, set a good example and give others room to grow.

When it comes to our concept, you should be motivated by creating more healthy, good-quality and affordable homes, and by striking a positive and understanding tone in our communication with tenants.

You will join the management team alongside colleagues in Finance, Construction, and Investment & Development, and you will report to co-CEO Philip Højberg Unger. You can meet the whole team at www.home.earth.

Could this be your next challenge?

If the role has caught your interest, please send your CV and a short cover letter through the form below. We interview on a rolling basis and will keep the position open until we find the right person, so it is never too late to apply. The position requires physical presence at our office in Copenhagen. If you have any questions about the role, you are very welcome to contact Philip Højberg Unger at philip@home.earth.

Please note that all our positions are open to applicants from all parts of society. We believe in the strength and potential of every person, regardless of race, religion or belief, ethnic origin, physical ability, family structure, socioeconomic background, age, nationality or citizenship, marital or partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other difference that makes you who you are!

Your responsibilities

• 
Continue and strengthen our work on building in-house property management, so that we can run our properties ourselves efficiently and in line with Home.Earth’s values, and build the relationships with our residents that we want.

• 
Set the direction for the operation of the portfolio and hold full P&L responsibility, including budgets, operating economics and returns on each property.

• 
Lead, motivate and develop your colleagues in property management, and recruit new team members as the portfolio grows.

• 
Prepare and follow up on business plans for the properties, and make the commercial decisions that improve results.

• 
Ensure a smooth handover and commissioning of new properties, both our own developments and acquisitions.

• 
Ensure that our distinctive Home.Earth tenant concepts, such as homes with no deposit and Gensidig Gevinst (Mutual Benefit), work in practice, and that lessons learned from operations are carried into the development of new properties.

• 
Ensure that property management complies with good practice, legal requirements and our values, and report on results to management and our investors.

We imagine that you…

Requirements

• 
Have at least 6 years of relevant experience, including at least 1 year as a manager, and a strong desire to work actively with people leadership.

• 
Have a professional background in the real estate industry within administration/legal, finance and controlling, or technical operations.

• 
Have experience with P&L responsibility and are used to working with budgets, returns and business plans.

• 
Thrive on switching between the strategic and the practical, and enjoy a wide variety of tasks.

• 
Have a strong relational approach to tenants, colleagues, authorities and partners.

• 
Are motivated by Home.Earth’s mission of “Homes That Care for People and Planet”.

What we offer

Purpose in the work

Help build homes people can afford, with a low carbon footprint.

Strong colleagues

Close collaboration with management and a broad group of experienced, strong colleagues who want to see you grow.

6 weeks holiday

Statutory holiday plus one extra week on top.

Occupational pension

Competitive pension scheme on top of your salary.

Health insurance

Full health insurance for you, and a discount for your family.

Flexible & hybrid

Flexible hours and up to 2 remote days per week.

How to apply

We look forward to hearing from you

Apply via the form below.

Location: _Søborg, Denmark. Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark or the Greater Malmö area in Sweden.

_Are you the type of person who enjoys understanding how things work, questioning assumptions, and solving complex technical problems?

We are looking for a Sr Reliability Engineer to help shape the future of our maintenance, calibration and asset management programs. This is not a traditional maintenance role. Instead, you will focus on understanding equipment risks, analysing failure mechanisms, evaluating maintenance effectiveness, and developing data-driven maintenance and calibration strategies.

Some days you will be deep in equipment data, conducting component-level risk assessments and reliability analyses. Other days you will be presenting your recommendations, challenging established practices, and facilitating discussions with stakeholders across Manufacturing, Quality, Compliance, Engineering, and Maintenance.

Whether you are an experienced reliability professional or an exceptional early-career engineer with strong analytical abilities, we are interested in hearing from you.

**What You'll Be Doing

**Risk Assessment & Reliability Engineering

• Perform detailed equipment, instrument and component-level risk assessments.

• Identify failure modes and evaluate their impact on safety, compliance, reliability, and operational performance.

• Conduct FMECA, criticality assessments, root cause analyses, and other reliability studies.

• Support a risk-based approach to maintenance decision-making.

Maintenance & Calibration Strategy Development

• Evaluate existing maintenance and calibration programs and challenge activities that do not deliver value.

• Redesign and optimize preventive, predictive, corrective, and condition-based maintenance and calibration strategies.

• Build maintenance and calibration programs based on risk, data, and equipment criticality.

• Develop practical recommendations that improve equipment reliability while optimizing resource utilization.

Data Analysis & Continuous Improvement

• Analyse maintenance and calibration history, failure data, asset performance trends, and reliability metrics.

• Identify patterns, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities.

• Convert complex data into actionable recommendations.

• Support the development of KPIs and performance monitoring tools.

• Support digitalization initiatives that improve data visibility, decision-making, and maintenance effectiveness across the organization.

• Develop and maintain reporting and analytical tools, including Power BI dashboards and visualizations, to support reliability, risk, and maintenance strategy decisions.

Stakeholder Collaboration

• Work closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Compliance, Engineering, and Maintenance teams.

• Facilitate discussions where priorities may differ and help build alignment around technical decisions.

• Present findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Support internal and external audits by presenting maintenance strategies, risk assessments, and technical rationales, and by clearly communicating decisions to auditors and regulatory stakeholders.

• Act as a subject matter expert during audits and inspections, presenting risk assessments, maintenance strategies, and technical justifications to auditors, Quality, and Compliance stakeholders.

**What We're Looking For

**We are less interested in the number of years on your CV and more interested in how you think.

**You Are Likely Someone Who

**

• Enjoys analysing complex technical problems.

• Is naturally curious and asks "why" before accepting a conclusion.

• Can work independently and stay focused on difficult problems.

• Is comfortable challenging established ways of working when supported by facts and data.

• Can communicate confidently with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

• Is persistent, resilient, and comfortable navigating disagreement.

• Can balance technical rigor with practical business realities.

**Qualifications

**You may be an experienced engineer or a recent graduate.

**We'd Like To See

**

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related technical discipline.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

• Interest in asset reliability, maintenance optimization, risk management, or data analysis.

• Ability to work with complex datasets and draw meaningful conclusions.

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, P&IDs, User Requirement Specifications, Technical Specifications, and equipment manufacturer manuals.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Fluency in English.

Experience with the following is considered an advantage but is not required:

• FMECA

• FMEA

• RCM (Reliability Centred Maintenance)

• Root Cause Analysis

• Asset Criticality Assessments

• Reliability Engineering

• Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS)

• Manufacturing, pharmaceutical, biotech, food, chemical, or process industries

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

**This Role Is Likely a Great Fit If You

**

• Enjoy working independently and becoming an expert in a technical area.

• Like digging into data until you fully understand a problem.

• Are comfortable having difficult conversations when the facts support your position.

• Prefer solving root causes rather than treating symptoms.

• Enjoy building new solutions instead of simply maintaining existing processes.

• Enjoy understanding how equipment works by combining field observations with technical drawings, P&IDs, manuals, performance data, and engineering principles.

• Want to have a genuine impact on how maintenance and reliability decisions are made.

What We Offer

• A unique opportunity to shape and improve maintenance strategy across critical assets.

• Exposure to cross-functional decision-making and collaboration with senior stakeholders.

• Significant autonomy, ownership, and freedom to drive improvements.

• An environment that values analytical thinking, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

• Opportunities for professional growth regardless of your level of experience.

• A highly visible role with the opportunity to influence decisions, drive change, and provide informal leadership across the organization.

**Join our team

**We are eager to welcome a new colleague as soon as possible. Please submit your application no later than 30 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the vacancy before the deadline if a suitable candidate is found.

Please apply exclusively through our recruitment system. Applications submitted through other channels will not be considered.

To support an inclusive and unbiased recruitment process, please do not include a photo in your CV. At AGC Biologics, we are committed to fair hiring practices and value diversity and inclusion throughout our recruitment process.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Sameer Ahmed, Senior Manager, Equipment Maintenance, at **sameer.ahmed@agc.com

**Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark or the Greater Malmö area in Sweden.

We look forward to receiving your application!

**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

Turn vulnerability data into actionable cyber risk intelligence

Cyber Defense is transforming how TDC Brands identifies, prioritises and manages cyber risk across one of Denmark's largest digital environments.

We are building a mature, risk-based Vulnerability Management capability spanning infrastructure, cloud, end-user devices, applications and third-party services.

To strengthen this capability, we are looking for a Vulnerability Intelligence & Analytics Manager who can turn complex vulnerability and asset data into trusted insights, meaningful reporting and measurable risk reduction.

You will be responsible for the data, analytics and platform foundation that enables Vulnerability Management across TDC Brands.

Your role

As Vulnerability Intelligence & Analytics Manager, you will take the lead on Vulnerability Management platforms, data, analytics and reporting within Cyber Defense.

Where our Senior Vulnerability Manager primarily drives the technical assessment and remediation discipline, you will ensure that we have the right data, tooling and intelligence to understand our exposure and measure how effectively risk is being reduced.

Together, the two roles form the core of our Vulnerability Management capability and will work closely together and provide mutual coverage when required.

You will work across Cyber Defense, infrastructure and application teams, technology partners and management to create transparency around vulnerabilities, remediation performance and cyber risk.

Key responsibilities

You will:

• Own and continuously develop Vulnerability Management platforms, reporting and analytics across TDC Brands

• Develop dashboards and reporting that provide clear visibility of vulnerabilities, exposure and remediation performance

• Define and maintain Vulnerability Management KPIs, KRIs, SLAs and other performance metrics

• Create operational, management and executive-level cyber risk reporting

• Integrate and correlate vulnerability, asset, threat and business-context data from multiple sources

• Monitor data quality and work with technology teams to improve asset coverage, accuracy and completeness

• Analyse trends, recurring vulnerabilities, risk concentrations and remediation effectiveness

• Develop and automate data flows, reporting processes and platform integrations

• Support governance processes including remediation follow-up, risk acceptance and exception management

• Work closely with the Senior Vulnerability Manager to continuously improve risk-based vulnerability prioritisation

• Support audit, compliance and regulatory reporting requirements

What we are looking for

You combine an understanding of cyber security with strong capabilities in analytics, platforms and data.

You are comfortable working with complex datasets but can also turn them into simple, credible insights that enable both technical teams and senior leaders to make better risk decisions.

We expect you to bring:

• 3–5+ years of relevant experience within cyber security, Vulnerability Management, security analytics, risk or a related discipline

• Experience working with vulnerability, security or technology data at enterprise scale

• Strong experience with Power BI, data modelling and dashboard development

• Experience defining and developing KPIs, KRIs and management reporting

• Understanding of Vulnerability Management concepts including CVEs, CVSS, remediation and risk-based prioritisation

• Experience integrating data from enterprise platforms such as Vulnerability Management tools, ServiceNow, CMDBs or security platforms

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to identify patterns, data-quality issues and meaningful trends

• Strong stakeholder management and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical specialists and senior management

Experience with technologies such as Power Query, SQL, KQL, APIs, Python or PowerShell will be an advantage.

Experience with Vulnerability Management platforms such as Rapid7, Microsoft Defender or similar, as well as knowledge of ITSM/CMDB is also valuable.

Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls or ISO 27001 is welcome but not required.

Why Cyber Defense at TDC Brands?

You will join a diverse Cyber Defense organisation of 13+ colleagues working across Vulnerability Management, Security Architecture, Security Operations and Identity & Access Management.

You will have the opportunity to:

• Shape the data and technology foundation of Vulnerability Management at TDC Brands

• Build transparency around cyber risk at enterprise scale

• Work with large and complex security and technology datasets

• Influence both operational improvements and senior management risk decisions

• Work closely with experienced Cyber Defense and technology specialists

• Develop your skills through professional training and certifications

• Be part of a team that helps secure national critical infrastructure

Application

The position is full-time with workplace at Teglholmsgade 1, Copenhagen or Sletvej 30, Aarhus, and we expect regular presence at one of our offices.

Desired start date is as soon as possible.

Candidates must be EU/EEA citizens and reside in Denmark.

About TDC Brands TDC Brands consists of a number of strong brands that together deliver innovative digital services within TV, broadband, network and telephony to private customers and businesses. YouSee, Telmore, Hiper and eesy serve Danes across age, gender and place of residence in the private market. TDC Brands currently employs around 3,000 people and has approximately 6 million private and business customer relationships. Read more about TDC Brands at tdcbrands.dk.

About TDC Brands

TDC Brands is home to YouSee, TDC Erhverv, Telmore, Hiper, eesy and Relatel — around 3,000 employees and roughly 6 million consumer and business customer relationships in Denmark. We are the commercial and service side of Danish telecom; TDC NET owns and runs the physical network.

We are putting AI to work across customer service, digital channels, sales and our own internal operations. Doing that in a company millions of Danes rely on means doing it carefully.

Why this role exists

AI governance fails in one of two ways. It becomes a review gate that slows everything down, or it becomes a document nobody reads. We want neither.

This role keeps governance close to the work. You’ll own the practical machinery — the use-case inventory, the risk assessments, the evaluation and testing — and you’ll sit inside the proof-of-concepts as they are built, not review them afterwards. It is a rare combination of skills, and a good place to build a career: governance people who can actually build are scarce, and getting scarcer.

What you’ll do

• Own the agent inventory. Maintain a live picture of every AI agent we run, and of the copilots, RAG applications and embedded model features around them — what each one does, what data and systems it can reach, what it is allowed to do without a human, who owns it, and where it sits against EU AI Act risk categories.

• Run the assessments. Work through risk, privacy and security reviews with Legal, Privacy and Security colleagues, and turn their requirements into something an engineering team can act on.

• Test what we build. Design and run evaluations: accuracy, hallucination, bias, prompt injection, tool misuse and failure behaviour. Build the test sets and keep them current as models and agents change.

• Help build the proof-of-concepts. Work hands-on alongside the AI Evangelist and delivery teams — preparing data, writing and refining prompts, wiring up APIs, measuring whether the thing actually works.

• Document it properly. Model cards, decision records and system documentation that stand up to an audit and are still readable by the people who have to use them.

• Watch the horizon. Track regulation, guidance and tooling as they evolve, and translate them into short, practical checklists rather than long policy documents.

Your first year

• A complete, trusted inventory across the six brands — agents and the AI applications around them — with risk classifications and ownership everyone agrees on.

• A working evaluation approach applied to at least two production or near-production systems.

• Assessment and documentation templates that teams reach for because they save time, not because they are mandatory.

• A reputation as the person engineers invite into a project early rather than call at the end.

What we’re looking for

• Around 4 years’ experience in data, AI, technology risk, compliance or a closely related field.

• Enough hands-on ability to be useful in a prototype: Python at a practical level — notebooks, scripts, calling APIs — and comfort with how LLM applications are put together. You do not need to be a software engineer.

• A working understanding of GDPR, and genuine interest in the EU AI Act and what it means in practice.

• Clear, structured writing. Much of this job is making complicated things legible to someone who has fifteen minutes.

• The confidence to ask an uncomfortable question in a room of senior people, and the judgement to know which questions are worth asking.

If you meet most of this and the rest is learnable, we’d still like to hear from you.

Also useful, not required

• Experience in a regulated industry — telecom, finance, health or public sector.

• Familiarity with evaluation tooling and frameworks for LLM applications.

• Experience with Azure AI, AWS or Google Cloud AI services.

• Exposure to ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF or similar management frameworks.

• Danish language skills — useful for stakeholder work, but not a requirement.

What you’ll get out of it

• Direct mentoring from senior AI and architecture colleagues, and close work with Legal, Privacy and Security.

• Visibility across six brands and both consumer and business markets — unusual breadth for an early-career role.

• A seat at the table while an enterprise AI practice is being built, rather than inheriting one already built.

Practical details

• Location: Teglholmsgade 1, Copenhagen. Hybrid, with four days a week on site.

• Team: You’ll join Data & AI, a team of around 40 people, working alongside the Senior AI Evangelist.

• Language: English is our main language of communication. Danish is an advantage.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note - half a page is plenty - on one AI risk you think companies currently underestimate, and what you would do about it. No formal cover letter needed.

Questions before applying? Contact Sunanda Sengupta at sunse@tdcbrands.dk

About TDC Brands

TDC Brands is home to YouSee, TDC Erhverv, Telmore, Hiper, eesy and Relatel — around 3,000 employees and roughly 6 million consumer and business customer relationships in Denmark. We are the commercial and service side of Danish telecom; TDC NET owns and runs the physical network.

That shapes this role. The AI opportunity here is in customer experience, service operations, digital channels, sales and the work of our own employees — millions of interactions every month, across six brands and two very different markets.

Why this role exists

We have a data foundation in place and several AI initiatives already underway. What this role adds is continuity: someone to take promising ideas through to production safely, and to help teams across the business get comfortable using them.

The work is part advocate, part builder. Expect to spend your time fairly evenly between convincing, designing and prototyping.

What you’ll do

• Find the work that matters. Cut through the long list of possible AI use cases and identify the handful — across customer service, digital channels, sales, support and internal productivity — with real value behind them.

• Bring people with you. Workshops, demos, mentoring and straight answers to executives about what AI will and won’t do for them. Build confidence and capability across teams that don’t start out fluent in this.

• Build, not just advise. You’ll prototype yourself. A credible working demo moves this organisation faster than a deck, and you’ll produce both.

• Design for production. Enterprise-grade patterns for LLM applications, RAG, agent orchestration and the surrounding API, data and identity plumbing, across a multi-brand landscape.

• Set the guardrails. Define our Responsible AI approach in practical terms: evaluation, human oversight, data privacy, model risk, EU AI Act and GDPR alignment — as engineering standards, not a policy PDF.

• Make the path repeatable. Turn one-off successes into reusable patterns so the second and third team move faster than the first.

Your first year

• Three to five high-value use cases identified, prototyped and assessed on evidence rather than enthusiasm.

• At least one of them live in production, with monitoring, evaluation and a named owner.

• A Responsible AI standard that teams actually use, because it comes with tooling and reference implementations.

• Colleagues across business and technology who can tell you, accurately, where AI fits in their work and where it doesn’t.

What we’re looking for

• 10+ years in technology, with depth in AI/ML, data or solution architecture.

• Hands-on experience building with generative and agentic AI — LLMs, RAG, agent orchestration, evaluation — not only overseeing it.

• A track record of taking systems into production in a large or regulated organisation, and of designing for security, privacy and failure.

• The presence to lead a room: excellent communication and storytelling, and the judgement to tell a real use case from an expensive demo — and to explain that difference to both engineers and executives.

• Comfort working across organisational boundaries in an international, distributed environment.

If you meet most of this and the rest is learnable, we’d still like to hear from you.

Also useful, not required

• Telecom domain knowledge — BSS/OSS, customer operations, order management, digital self-service channels.

• Experience with Azure AI, AWS or Google Cloud AI services.

• Familiarity with AI security, model risk management, observability and evaluation frameworks.

• Experience defining governance that engineering teams adopt willingly.

• Relevant certifications in cloud, AI, data or security.

Eriksholm generates scientific insights and explores new technologies with the potential to improve future hearing care. We work closely with scientists, engineers, and Oticon R&D to ensure that promising ideas can be translated into solutions with meaningful impact for people with hearing loss.

Kvalitetssikringsmedarbejder søges til Firesafe Danmark A/S

Har du øje for kvalitet, teknisk forståelse og lyst til at arbejde tæt på byggeprocessen?

Hos Firesafe Danmark A/S søger vi to kvalitetssikringsmedarbejdere til at styrke vores kvalitetssikring inden for passiv brandsikring og isolering. Vi søger strukturerede og kvalitetsbevidste medarbejdere med teknisk forståelse.

Du får en varieret hverdag, hvor du kombinerer praktiske kvalitetstilsyn på byggepladsen med teknisk opfølgning og dokumentation. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med montører, projektledere og øvrige kolleger.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

·         Udføre løbende kvalitetstilsyn og kontrol af passiv brandsikring og isoleringsarbejde.

·         Kontrollere, at arbejdet udføres i overensstemmelse med tekniske tegninger, montagevejledninger og gældende krav.

·         Identificere kvalitetsafvigelser og følge op på nødvendige udbedringer.

·         Udarbejde og vedligeholde kvalitetsdokumentation samt registrere og følge op på opgaver i Dalux og BIM.

·         Vejlede montører i korrekte arbejdsmetoder og tekniske løsninger, herunder demonstrere korrekt udførelse.

·         Samarbejde med ledelsen om tekniske afklaringer, koordinering og kvalitetsopfølgning.

Vi forventer, at du:

•         Har teknisk forståelse og interesse for kvalitetssikring.

•         Kan læse og forstå bygningstegninger og teknisk dokumentation.

•         Arbejder selvstændigt, systematisk og følger dine opgaver til dørs.

•         Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk, både mundtligt og skriftligt.

•         Er fortrolig med digitale værktøjer og har lyst til at arbejde med kvalitetsdokumentation.

•         Kan vejlede montører og følge op på kvaliteten af det udførte arbejde.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har:

•         Erfaring med kvalitetssikring og kontrol i byggebranchen.

•         Kendskab til passiv brandsikring, isolering eller lignende teknisk arbejde.

•         Erfaring med Dalux og BIM.

•         Gode danskkundskaber og kendskab til flere sprog.

Der stilles ikke krav om en bestemt uddannelse, dog er det en fordele hvis man har en teknisk baggrund. 

Vi tilbyder

•         Fast fuldtidsstilling på minimum 37 timer om ugen.

•         Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

•         Løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring samt pension og øvrige vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

•         Firmatelefon, computer og andet relevant udstyr i forbindelse med arbejdet.

•         En varieret arbejdsdag med både praktiske og administrative opgaver.

•         Et arbejdsmiljø med gode kolleger og mulighed for faglig udvikling.

Om Firesafe Danmark A/S

Firesafe Danmark A/S arbejder med passiv brandsikring og relaterede tekniske ydelser på byggeprojekter. Vi bidrager til at beskytte mennesker, bygninger og værdier gennem korrekt udførelse og dokumentation af brandtekniske løsninger.

Hos os bliver du en del af en organisation, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og ansvarlighed er i fokus.

Ansøgning

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig?

Send dit CV og en kort beskrivelse af din motivation for at søge jobbet til info@firesafe.dk

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Søren Christiansen soeren.christiansen@firesafe.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

 

  

Quality Assurance Employee Wanted at Firesafe Danmark A/S

Do you have an eye for detail, a strong technical understanding, and a passion for ensuring high quality workmanship on construction sites?

Firesafe Danmark A/S is looking to recruit two Quality Assurance Employees to strengthen our quality assurance team within passive fire protection and insulation works.

In this role, you will combine on-site quality inspections with technical follow-up and documentation. You will work closely with installers, project managers, and other members of the project team to ensure that installations meet the required quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

•         Conduct regular QA/QC inspections of passive fire protection and insulation works on-site.

•         Verify that installations comply with approved drawings, installation instructions, project specifications, and applicable requirements.

•         Identify non-conformities and follow up on corrective actions to ensure proper close-out.

•         Prepare and maintain quality documentation, inspection records, and reports, including the registration and follow-up of quality-related issues in Dalux and BIM models.

•         Provide technical guidance to installers on approved installation methods and demonstrate correct workmanship when required.

•         Coordinate with the project team regarding technical clarifications, site activities, and quality-related matters.

About You

We are looking for a responsible, structured, and solution-oriented individual with strong attention to detail. You are comfortable working both on construction sites and in a site office, and you can communicate effectively with different trades and project stakeholders.

We expect you to:

•         Have a good technical understanding and a strong interest in quality assurance and quality control.

•         Be able to read and interpret construction drawings and technical documentation.

•         Work independently, systematically, and take ownership of your tasks.

•         Communicate effectively in English or Danish, both verbally and in writing.

•         Be comfortable using digital tools for inspections and quality documentation.

•         Be confident in guiding installers and following up on the quality of completed work.

 

It would be an advantage if you have:

•         Previous experience in QA/QC, quality inspections, or construction site supervision.

•         Knowledge of passive fire protection, insulation, or similar construction activities.

•         Experience working with Dalux and BIM.

•         Hands-on construction site experience, including providing technical guidance to installers.

•         Good Danish language skills and knowledge of additional languages.

A specific educational background is not required. We value relevant practical experience, technical understanding, and the right attitude.

What We Offer

•         A permanent, full-time position with a minimum of 37 working hours per week.

•         Start date as soon as possible or by agreement.

•         Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience, including pension and other employment benefits in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and employment contract.

•         Company phone and the possibility of a company vehicle, depending on project requirements.

•         A varied workday combining on-site inspections with office-based QA/QC activities.

•         A supportive and informal working environment with opportunities for professional development.

About Firesafe Danmark A/S

Firesafe Danmark A/S specialises in passive fire protection and related technical services within the construction industry.

Our work contributes to protecting people, buildings, and assets by ensuring that fire protection systems are correctly installed, inspected, and documented in accordance with project specifications and applicable requirements.

You will become part of a team where quality, teamwork, and accountability are at the core of our daily operations.

How to Apply

Interested in joining our team?

Please submit your CV along with a short description of your motivation for applying to info@firesafe.dk

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact Søren Christiansen soeren.christiansen@firesafe.dk for further information.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Our company works with various construction and renovation projects, including the planning, coordination, and execution of technical installations and building-related activities.

As a Technical Project Manager, you will play a central role in planning, managing, and coordinating our technical project activities. You will be responsible for coordinating technical installations, project follow-ups, quality assurance, and cooperation with construction workers, technicians, suppliers, and other project managers.

This position is particularly suitable for candidates with an educational background in Industrial Automation, Instrumentation, or related technical disciplines who wish to apply their technical knowledge within the construction and contracting industry.
